text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time has passed since Agnes Tachyon 
made what was effectively a retirement 
declaration—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Days of running at full sprint toward the 
Nippon Derby continued.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like I've gained quite a bit of 
speed. My core is feeling stable too, so 
with this—"

text_block_list.name: Lip-Pierced Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Pokke-san's in a rough mood again 
today. Even though it's been a while since 
Tachyon-san left.

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Training while being super pissed off is, 
in a way, seriously impressive, y'know~?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Her form, her speed, it's all brute force 
and reckless... It's like she's throwing 
her raw emotions directly into it.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: And yet... as expected of Pokke-chan!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"She's become even stronger than she was 
back at the Satsuki Sho...!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
As I am right now, I won't reach it at 
all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Agnes Tachyon leaving the center 
stage, as an Umamusume expected to conquer 
the Japanese Derby—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
People were beginning to hear Jungle 
Pocket's name everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*! Ah, shit, shit shit shit 
shit...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Nggghhh!! Ah, damn it!! Son of a 
biiitch...!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Way to go, Dants! That chunky side of ya 
is nowhere to be seen!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...Turns out I didn't know a single thing 
about you, huh."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm not giving up the Nippon Derby to 
anyone.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
That belongs to me. That's my stage. I 
won't let anyone take it from me.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Right there... Next time, I'll prove that 
I'm the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not giving it up either! The Japanese 
Derby!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With feelings for victory in her heart—

text_block_list.name: Lip-Pierced Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Pokke-san... Are you done being 
irritated?

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Phew, what a relief. It was so rough out 
there, I was sweating bullets thinking you 
might end up getting hurt—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The days of racing forward to reach the 
spotlight continue.
